$ cat testdata/checks/paths.txt
export evaluate: parse has no cell of export/prices
export evaluate: resolve has no cell of export/prices
export evaluate: through resolve, parse, import
export import: through no lift
$ go test  # used-fewer-a
    the lift parse is used by ./b on the path testdata/export/ → import → parse, and ., which owns it, doesn't run it over testdata/export/, so no package writes its cells of that corpus's cases, which ./b's cells past it are built through.
        A package that uses a lift reaches it from each corpus by the path the lift's owner does. Register in . the corpus type of testdata/export/ and the lifts on the path, each with hypercase.Own or hypercase.Use. If . does already, a registry is stale: run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which rewrites the registry of every package with tests.
    the lift resolve is used by ./b on the path testdata/export/ → import → parse → resolve, and ., which owns it, doesn't run it over testdata/export/, so no package writes its cells of that corpus's cases, which ./b's cells past it are built through.
        A package that uses a lift reaches it from each corpus by the path the lift's owner does. Register in . the corpus type of testdata/export/ and the lifts on the path, each with hypercase.Own or hypercase.Use.
